contract_rules.acceptance_join: A task joins only after every declared dependency has an accepted ancestry-bound receipt; its own receipt is produced after its checks and is never a prerequisite for itself.
contract_rules.integration: Compare-and-swap the expected parent and reverify after integration; graph metadata never authorizes dispatch.
contract_rules.parallelization: Tasks at equal dependency depth are only candidates; writable-scope conflicts serialize, and every parallel join is reverified on the combined parent.
